text:
Leah (CS): Quick flag  several eu-central dedicated tenants reported stale search results after an overnight maintenance window. Opening thread to coordinate customer comms and remediation.

Omar (SRE): Investigating now. Early metric: embed-writer throughput dropped after a failover event in the dedicated pool; backlog spiked and a few backfills timed out.

Priya (Eng): Root cause initial triage: during failover the shard-mapping service returned a temporary 503 for a subset of shards; our rewriter retried less aggressively and some jobs expired from the queue. Canary didn't catch it because the canary traffic didn't hit those shards.

Chris (Support): Affected tickets: DS-710, DS-718, DS-725. Customers asking if vectors can be recovered and ETA for fresh results.

Omar (SRE): No permanent data loss. We requeued expired jobs and ran a prioritized backfill. Most tenants are fresh as of 02:10 UTC. Adding alert: embed-backlog > 40 for >10m will page infra.

Leah (CS): Comms asks: 1) send immediate short status to affected customers; 2) prepare expanded RCA + timeline for renewal-risk accounts; 3) propose compensation (trial extension/credit) and invite to office hours.

Priya (Eng): Draft short status: "We observed delayed embedding updates for a small group of eu-central dedicated tenants during a failover event. The underlying shard-mapper returned transient errors which caused some backfills to expire. We requeued and prioritized backfill; embeddings are current for known impacted tenants. No customer vectors were lost. Please reply if you continue to see stale results."

Nora (Solutions): For renewal-risk accounts suggest 2-week extension + 2-hr troubleshooting session. For trials suggest 72-hour extension. We should offer a private walkthrough for any demo failures.

Chris (Support): I'll push the short status to all open tickets now and mark the ones flagged as renewal-risk for the exec RCA.

DeployBot: Failover rollback and backfill trigger completed at 02:05 UTC  system health green. :white_check_mark:

Omar (SRE): Prevention plan to include in RCA: increase rewriter retry window during shard-mapper errors, add shard-aware canary traffic, and add capacity soft-limits to reduce failover blast radius.

Priya (Eng): Also adding CI test that simulates shard-mapper 503s to ensure canary coverage. We'll add a post-deploy smoke that verifies embed freshness across 5 synthetic shards.

Leah (CS): Final checklist: 1) Chris to send short status now (done) 2) Priya/Omar to confirm backfill job IDs and attach to tickets 3) Leah to send tailored exec RCA + compensation offers by 14:00 UTC and schedule office hours.

Chris (Support): Short status posted and job IDs attached to tickets. Customers acknowledging; a couple requested immediate walkthroughs.

Leah (CS): Thanks team. I'll assemble the renewal-risk list and send the exec emails after attaching the RCA timeline. Will paste final sent copy here for audit. :pray:
